context: Thumb-driven mobile web app for Indonesian couples managing groceries at traditional markets.

bottom_nav.layout: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto h-20 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-border flex justify-around items-center px-2 z-50

card.style: bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-border relative overflow-hidden

button_primary.style: bg-primary text-white rounded-xl min-h-[56px] px-6 font-bold flex items-center justify-center w-full active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform shadow-md

button_accent.style: bg-accent text-white rounded-xl min-h-[56px] px-6 font-bold flex items-center justify-center w-full active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform shadow-md

chip.style: px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-muted text-primary text-sm font-medium border border-border whitespace-nowrap active:bg-accent active:text-white

layout.app_container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-background pb-24 relative shadow-xl overflow-hidden
layout.header: pt-8 pb-4 px-6 sticky top-0 bg-background/90 backdrop-blur-md z-40 flex items-center justify-between

login_hero.description: Couple cooking together in a warm kitchen. Use for login background.

empty_state_groceries.description: Fresh vegetables flatlay. Use as an accent image.

icons.usage: Use crisp, medium-weight icons. Size 24px for bottom nav, 20px for inline actions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text on background meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements MUST have a minimum dimension of 48x48 pixels.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for a mobile form factor using 'max-w-md mx-auto' to simulate a mobile app container centered on desktop displays.
Update tailwind.config.js to include 'Outfit' (headings) and 'Figtree' (body) fonts.
Implement bottom tab navigation consisting of: Stok Kulkas, Meal Planner, Daftar Belanja, Riwayat. Keep it sticky at the bottom using Fixed positioning. Ensure the main container has pb-24.
Create a Login screen (Google Auth) + Household invite code screen with the 'login_hero' image as a warm header background.
Build the 'Weekly Meal Planner' (Senin-Minggu) displaying Sarapan, Makan Siang, Makan Malam. Include input with ingredient suggestion chips.
Build 'Stok Kulkas' (Fridge inventory) as a simple, thumb-friendly list without quantities.

Build 'Daftar Belanja' (Grocery list) grouped by category (Sayuran, Bumbu Dapur, Daging/Protein, Kebutuhan Rumah). CRITICAL: Use massive custom checkboxes (w-8 h-8 or w-10 h-10) for one-handed operation.
Include 'Generate Daftar Belanja' and 'Selesai Belanja Minggu Ini' buttons where applicable. Include 'Gunakan Menu Ini Lagi' in the History screen.
Ensure all text is in Bahasa Indonesia.
Do not use generic Shadcn cards everywhere; use soft rounded-2xl containers with the warm, earthy color palette.
Apply `data-testid` attributes aggressively to all buttons, tabs, checkboxes, and input fields.
